review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve thinking blocks before adopting the thinking-enabled default**

When Sonnet 5.5 uses its default adaptive thinking before a tool call, the existing response parser discards its `thinking`/`redacted_thinking` blocks, and `runDiscoveryAgent` reconstructs an assistant message containing only the tool calls. `toAnthropicMessage()` consequently sends only `tool_use` blocks on the next request. Anthropic requires the original signed thinking blocks when continuing with the corresponding tool results, so this causes the next `/messages` request to be rejected and aborts multi-turn discovery. Either explicitly disable thinking for this provider or preserve the untouched thinking blocks through `ChatResponse`, `Message`, and assistant-message serialization before making this the default.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
